recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no source follow-up is needed for FHIR-22746 unless a later work group decision changes AdverseEvent.code semantics or value set scope.
issue_request: FHIR-22746 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and asked to rename AdverseEvent.event to AdverseEvent.code, update the short and definition text, and narrow the AdverseEvent type value set to SNOMED CT fall (1912002) plus serious reportable event descendants (370894009).
initial_application: The Jira comment points to commit e07c2ff1ac898dde0686f31a089dd8fb9bbfb14e, which changed the spreadsheet/example from event to code, updated the requested text, and narrowed the value set. Commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 later carried that content into the current XML StructureDefinition, value set, and search parameter bundle.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists AdverseEvent as an active resource, and the only current AdverseEvent.event occurrence found is the R4-to-R6 mapping to AdverseEvent.code. FHIR-22735 previously changed the binding to clinical-findings, but FHIR-22746 later narrowed it. FHIR-22745 shared the implementation commit but addressed separate TODO cleanup. Corrected Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion, and Confluence minutes corroborate the July 18, 2019 Patient Care meeting context.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative source already implements the requested rename, descriptions, value set composition, search parameter code/expression, and version mapping.

related_jiras.note: Shared implementation commit e07c2ff, but it addressed separate AdverseEvent TODO cleanup and was not decided here.
